integrity: Self-reviewed derivation from the cited geometric construction and standard intersection formulas; independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Requires a very general complex abelian surface of type (1,6) with Neron-Severi group generated by the primitive polarization and endomorphism ring Z.
Excludes equality to one product of integral Cartier divisor classes only; does not exclude rational linear combinations or rational multiples of divisor products.
Does not settle whether the canonical image is a (2,2,3) complete intersection or any Hodge-conjecture question.
title: A divisibility obstruction for a Lagrangian Albanese cycle
